title: The noyb question: proving rights, consent and contestability at execution time — June 2026

citations.claim: noyb (None of Your Business), the European digital-rights NGO founded by Max Schrems, enforces data-protection rights through strategic litigation, standard-setting cases and complaints — pressing organisations to demonstrate, not merely assert, that they complied.
citations.publisher: noyb — European Center for Digital Rights. Cited as a digital-rights enforcement actor, not as a statement of law.

citations.claim: The GDPR gives data subjects enforceable rights — access (Article 15), rectification (16), objection (21) and the right not to be subject to a solely-automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect (22) — exercisable against the controller.
citations.publisher: Official Journal of the European Union (Regulation (EU) 2016/679, GDPR)
